title: Madhabi Puri Buch: Making Your Online Financial Advice Safer
description: SEBI Chairperson Madhabi Puri Buch is leading efforts to make online financial advice trustworthy. The market regulator is tightening rules for "finfluencers".

faq.a: Madhabi Puri Buch is the current Chairperson of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI), the regulatory body for India's stock and securities market. She is the first woman to hold this position.
A "finfluencer" is a portmanteau of "financial influencer," referring to individuals who create and share financial content, advice, or recommendations on social media platforms.

faq.q: Can I still follow finfluencers for financial tips?
faq.a: You can follow finfluencers for general financial education and awareness. However, for specific investment advice or recommendations on buying/selling stocks, it is crucial to consult only SEBI-registered Investment Advisers or Research Analysts.

faq.q: What if a finfluencer gives me a "sure shot" stock tip?
faq.a: Be very cautious. Registered professionals are bound by strict rules and cannot guarantee returns. Unregistered individuals giving "sure shot" tips might be involved in manipulative practices, and following such advice can lead to significant financial losses.

faq.q: What are SEBI's future plans regarding finfluencers?
faq.a: SEBI is continuing to evolve its regulatory framework, including discussions around a "Common Advertisement Code" and potentially introducing measures like a "Verified Finfluencer Badge" to further enhance transparency and investor protection.
